# Consumer Products

# Consumer Products

Scale still matters, but it’s not enough

## Our Experience

The consumer products industry has faced a relentless wave of disruption—from a global pandemic to inflation, supply chain breakdowns, and mounting environmental pressure. Category volumes remain soft. Pricing power is hitting its limit. And consumer behavior keeps evolving, while private label and insurgent brands gain traction across the globe.

But the best consumer packaged goods companies (CPGs) aren’t standing still. They’re leveraging technology, streamlining portfolios, and reinventing their go-to-market models to outpace the competition. Our consumer products consulting expertise enables you to navigate complexity, anticipate risk, and unlock new sources of growth.

On your journey to full potential, we can help you:

Our clients include companies in the food, beverage, personal and household care, consumer durables, luxury goods, apparel and footwear, recreational products, and over-the-counter medicines sectors. The breadth of our experience and expertise, combined with our broad ecosystem of best-in-class partners, ensures that we tailor powerful solutions that meet your exact needs.

## Our Consumer Products Services

## Our Consumer Products Services

### Consumer-led Brand Growth

A powerful, data-driven solution that puts consumers at the heart of your growth strategy. Discover how the Bain Brand Accelerator can help you break free from a category view of the world, refocus on consumers’ needs, grow and nurture brands through multi-year value creation plans, and much more.

### Commercial Excellence

Navigate the tectonic shifts in retail to accelerate growth. We work with you across five distinct pillars of commercial excellence to identify the true sources of value and deliver on them. We also help you transform your organizational operating model and enhance your technology capabilities to support your commercial excellence strategy.

### Digitalization in Consumer Products

Become a digital performance leader by fusing technology, data, and organizational design. We help hundreds of CPG companies develop best-in-class digital strategies that direct your investments to the priority initiatives that will generate the most value.
